race.description: Ladbrokes Racing Extra In Multi Mdn Plate
race.comment: MEAN ZIPPER (2) earns top billing after going under by only a head at Innisfail first-up, when he travelled well, picked up impressively and still had a case after racing keenly and being forced wide. The move to 1250m is new, but that fresh run says he can make an impact here. BETTER OPTION (5) is the obvious danger after being beaten half a length at Townsville despite losing ground early, being held up on the home turn and having difficulty getting clear at the 350m. He is third-up, has already placed at this distance and brings Lacey Morrison, the top-ranked jockey for wins at this track. Key runner. ASTERIDE (7) resumes after over a year away, yet her only start at this venue was a head second and that makes her dangerous if forward enough fresh. DEE THREE (6) has been freshened since closing into fourth at this track and his prior Open run at Townsville gives him enough depth for a place claim.
